owned_production_slice.baseline_trace: runtime_proxy/lib.rs::runtime_proxy_request_header_value selects the first matching header, trims it and filters blank values. runtime_request_explicit_session_id chains session_id/session-id/x-session-id with or_else; only then does runtime_request_session_id fall back to turn metadata and body. local_rewrite_pipeline_dispatch validates the resolved hard-binding identity before provider dispatch.
owned_production_slice.change: Remove found-state; return the first nonblank alias instead of stopping on a blank earlier name. Preserve first occurrence within duplicate header names, nonblank alias priority, trim rules and metadata/body fallback.
owned_production_slice.source_correction: The earlier native assertion that blank session_id suppresses a later alias was inaccurate. It is corrected to pinned source and live behavior; no broad exact session-precedence claim relies on that old assertion.

production_differential.zero_side_effects: Two resolved oversized aliases reject with the pinned 503 JSON/cache/nosniff response and no provider POSTs. Four accepted independent identities each send one POST with authoritative synthetic credentials.
production_differential.isolation: Valid session identifiers are distinct across turns so ownership acquired by an earlier accepted request cannot change a later alias-selection observation.
